# Studio 51 VFX (also known as Studio 51 and Studio 51 VFX)

> Studio 51 VFX is a full-pipeline visual effects and animation studio with teams in Mumbai, Hyderabad, Beijing, Shanghai and London. We deliver VFX from concept to final render for film, television, streaming, games and immersive experiences.

## Services (full VFX pipeline)
Concept design, previsualisation, matchmove, roto animation, rotoscopy, paint, lighting, animation, FX, environments, digital matte painting (DMP), creature animation, modelling, rigging, texturing, compositing.
